name: 28023 · China Grove, NC
findings: ZIP 28023 (China Grove) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28023 (China Grove) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28023 (China Grove) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
